$comment: Blind rater AV on build 631fe23, seed 3102, served at :5230, headed GPU driver 400x800 @3x. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3, the template (plus tools/driver.mjs header for the ops). Did not open PLAN.md, research/, docs/CUT*.md, other cards or source. Raw notes: scratchpad/raterAV/notes.txt.

absences.result: 1 offline run, rested 20m, banked $305 at D10; PLATEAU card; party choice; forge pending
8 offline runs (heirs 6-9), 5 returned, 3 died (jackal D9, goblin D8, wraith D10), +$602 returned, $843 lost, 3 verdicts to read
16 offline runs, 6 banked at D12, 9 returned, 1 death (eel), +$1648 banked +$1192 returned; PLATEAU card again; forge/unlock/party spend

horizon.runsWatchedNote: 9 at plain 1x (runs 1,2,3,5,16,19,22,24,29), ~20 in the watch's 'fights' mode; 6 more resolved with fast or skip
horizon.ruleEditsNote: all 18 written by hand in the editor (add/rewrite/reorder/threshold); 0 offered patches applied (measured patches were read on every death; most read 'drops R_' or 'all harm')
horizon.bestDepth: D13 (Fens bottom); D14 crypt 'sealed by mother', never reached

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: Heir 3, the curious fighter, went down with the boss row I had written after the Warlord drove heir 2 off at D8 ('counter unwritten'). At D8 my R3 'foe: boss → attack boss' fired and 'The Warlord breaks', but it left him at 4 HP with $210 carried. My 20% return row turned him home ('R2 return saved him'), he walked out with $126, and the chronicle now reads 'took the Warlord'.

probes.clarity: The forecast shaft answered every edit in seconds ('death 96→14%' when I moved my return row above attack), but after the gas death I spent four minutes blaming my own rows for 'death 4→28%' when the real cause was my two jackals having died ('PARTY 0/2').
probes.decisions: Moving bank from depth ≥ 12 to ≥ 13 read 'D13 0→32% · bank 66→32% · death 6→18%'; I took it for the bounty, banked $486 at D13, and would do it again, but I would not do the ≥ 14 mother hunt again ('bank 2%').
probes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know that row order shadows ('R8 ↑ R6'), that 'send skips rest' sends a hurt heir (heir 4 started a run at 9/40), or that a percentage heal can't trip once max HP drains; my depth went D6 → D8 → D11 → D12 → D13.
probes.tension: I sweated watching 'carry $201 · return keeps $120 · death $0 · returning' at 7/38 with the Warlord and an ogre on screen, and lost all $201 ('ogre −6')—the game noticed with a GAP stamp and a 'grudge: Thim the ogre'.
probes.feel: The pixel hero and ogre read well under torchlight, and the big 'R2 RETURN' callout lands on the moment, but in one frame it sat on top of the chips 'stolen darkness scroll · hp 11/38 · clear confusion'; audio cues fire in window.__audio (strike, slay, rule, hit) but I could not hear them—unassessed.
probes.surprise: 'The monkey stole the bow +1.', 'Found ♟1's bones: 7 items.', 'The den wakes: thieves on every side.', a pink jelly that splits, a wraith that follows a retreat, and 'The floor is hungry. It feeds on him.' each made me add or rewrite a row; after the 8h return the runs became 'Banked $298', 'Banked $279'.
probes.expression: My set: heal <40%, return <30%, boss focus, retreat under 40% with two foes, bank at D13, archers first, then nearest—a cautious banker who kills bosses, not what the forecast's patches would have built (they kept offering 'hp < 50% → return').
probes.story: The chronicle reads '♟3 the curious fighter · D8 · took the Warlord · found ♟2's bones · fell to an ogre · left bones on D8' and grudges pay off ('Thim the ogre is avenged.'), but the reel said 'R2 return saved him.' four runs running and once 'A goblin took him to 40 HP'.
probes.pacing: A watched run is 40–110 s with a line every 3 s at 1x; a check-in (read verdict → edit → send) was 2–4 min; the cadence was distinct: 20m gave one tidy banked run, 4h gave eight runs and three deaths, 8h gave sixteen runs and $2.8k to spend; the drag was two-tap confirms (forge 'ok', hatch 'ok', leash 'drop') and the last eight runs being identical D13 banks.
probes.failure: 'wraith · D10 · R8 under R3 · ORDER' told me my own retreat row had walked him backwards from a wraith five times ('R3 retreat 2 → 1 → 0'), and the patch list said honestly 'patches tie · all harm' when nothing would have helped; the 'heal unused' gas death at 6 HP ('R1 hp not <30%') never showed the drained max HP that explained it.
probes.social: My jackals have names (Thusk, Drix, Theth, Drim) and die in lists ('◯ jackal Thusk fell'); nothing develops between us.
probes.autonomy: I chose to go hunting the D13 'mother' to unseal the crypt, against the forecast, and to tame a jackal for the ledger's empty TAMED column—neither was asked of me.
probes.progression: Rows 2 → 8, verbs throw/tame, class rogue, supplies 3 → 5, auto: insure, auto: keep weapon+armour, party 1 → 2, forge leather/mail/sword +2, renown ★12; but every forge chip read '≈' ('mail · D11 ≈ ±12'), so the big purchases felt inert.
probes.aesthetic: Painted camp key art (two heroes descending into a green-lit ruin), torch-lit pixel floors and a parchment report; the lower third of the watch map was often empty black.
probes.return: After 8h I came back to '16 RUNS · 6 BANKED · 9 RETURNED · 1 DEATHS', a PLATEAU card ('R2 return ended 8 runs, none past D12'), $3,137 and a forge/unlock/party list; I decided to push bank to D13 because of it, and would not rather have stayed.
probes.attribution: My retelling of the wraith death: 'my retreat row killed him'; of the Warlord kill: 'my boss row did it'—the trace confirms both ('t11993 R3 attack boss ← goblin warlord slain D8'); the two gas deaths felt like the dungeon's, not mine.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: "death 96→14%" appeared the second I moved my return row up; misreads: forecast diff said 'R2 now → dies' when the jump was my dead party, bounty payout never stated after 'bounty D13 · missed', hp chip 9/40 vs portrait 10/40.
"D13 0→32% · bank 66→32% · death 6→18%" is a real, foreseeable bank-or-push choice I made and defend. Lapse: every forge purchase reads '≈' ('sword +2 · D13 ≈ ±8'), so kit spending is not a decision.

Records went D6 → D8 → D11 → D12 → D13 as I learned shadowing ('↑ R2'), the rest trade and the drain/heal-threshold fix (death 7→2%). Lapse: the D13 wall—'D14 · sealed by mother', mother fight at 2%—left the last 15 minutes with nothing new to learn.

"carry $201 · return keeps $120 · death $0 · returning" at 7/38 then 'ogre −6': chosen stakes, resolved on screen; but once banking at D13 was set, runs banked $268–$486 with nothing in doubt, and offline runs resolve unseen.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: "R2 · return" callout and hit flashes land in time on the GPU at 3x; one frame had 'R2 RETURN' pixel title over the stat chips. Audio unassessed (cues logged in window.__audio, not heard).

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: "The monkey stole the bow +1." / "Found ♟1's bones" / splitting jellies / a following wraith / hunger drain each changed a row. Lapse: after the 8h return every run was 'Banked $2xx' at D13.

Seven hand-written rows ("depth ≥ 13 → bank", "hp < 40% · foes ≥ 2 → retreat") make a cautious banker I'd recognise, but the space converged fast to heal/return/boss/bank and several verbs I bought (throw, blink) never earned a row.

"♟3 the curious fighter · D8 · took the Warlord · found ♟2's bones · fell to an ogre" plus grudge → 'Thim the ogre is avenged.' Lapse: reel repeated 'R2 return saved him.' four runs in a row and garbled 'A goblin took him to 40 HP'.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: 1x run 40–110 s, a line every ~3 s; check-ins 2–4 min; cadence distinct (1 / 8 / 16 runs). Friction: 'heir rests 20m · send skips rest' made active play send hurt heirs (9/40 start), two-tap confirms on forge/hatch/drop, and the late loop repeated.

axes.note: "wraith · D10 · R8 under R3 · ORDER" with each row's state ('R2 return · no way ← wraith holds the way') and 'patches tie · all harm'. Lapse: the 'heal unused' gas deaths hid the drained max HP that kept 'hp < 30%' from firing at 6 HP.
weight 0 (named pets that die in lists; no relationship).
Route fork ('burrows D8 59% / fens D8 32%'), bank depth, mother hunt and taming were my own goals; but the fork is taken once and the crypt seal leaves one path.

Rows 2→8, verbs, class, supplies 3→5, 'auto: insure', 'auto: keep weapon+armour', party 1→2, ★12, each tied to runs. Lapse: forge upgrades ($300–$2400) all forecast '≈', so the largest sink felt inert.
Painted key art and torch-lit pixel floors worth looking at; lower third of the watch map often empty black, some overlapping overlays. Sound not heard.
